title: submitTrainingJob fails: missing google-cloud-aiplatform module
summary: submitTrainingJob with kind=style-lora on A100 spot failed because infra/vertex/submit-training.py crashes with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'google'. The google-cloud-aiplatform package isn't installed in the Python env that the Node server shells out to. Blocks all Vertex submissions.

context.error: python-exit-1: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'google' (infra/vertex/submit-training.py line 25)

title: submitTrainingJob: Vertex rejects machineType 'a2-highgpu-1g' for every acceleratorType
summary: After installing google-cloud-aiplatform, submitTrainingJob now reaches Vertex but every submission returns 400 'Machine type a2-highgpu-1g is not supported.' regardless of the acceleratorType parameter (tried A100_80GB, A100_40GB, L4 — all same error). Suggests infra/vertex/submit-training.py is hardcoding machineType='a2-highgpu-1g' and not mapping from acceleratorType, OR the target region has no A100 availability and we need to either change region or pick a supported machine family (g2-standard-* for L4, n1 for T4). Blocks all Vertex training.

context.observed: Same error returned regardless of acceleratorType (NVIDIA_A100_80GB, NVIDIA_A100_40GB, NVIDIA_L4) — implies submit-training.py is hardcoded to a2-highgpu-1g and ignores the acceleratorType arg, OR the region (us-central1?) doesn't offer A100 quota.

title: submitTrainingJob: post-patch error unchanged, acceleratorType still ignored
summary: After the patch that threads machineType through and switches default region to europe-west4, submitTrainingJob still returns the identical error '400 Machine type a2-highgpu-1g is not supported' even when acceleratorType=NVIDIA_L4 is passed explicitly. Strongly suggests the patched code is not being executed (server not restarted? wrong codepath for style-lora?). Worth verifying: (1) Node server was restarted after the patch, (2) style-lora kind actually routes through submitAceStepLoraTrainingVertex, (3) europe-west4 currently has a2-highgpu-1g spot capacity.

context.hypothesis: Either the Node server is still running pre-patch code (needs restart/HMR reload) OR style-lora doesn't route through submitAceStepLoraTrainingVertex, OR europe-west4 also rejects a2-highgpu-1g spot right now.

title: style-lora submit hardcodes machineType a2-highgpu-1g; incompatible with NVIDIA_L4
summary: User asked to submit a style-lora training job on NVIDIA_L4 spot with g2-standard-12. proposeTrainingJob and submitTrainingJob both bake machineType='a2-highgpu-1g' into the merged config regardless of acceleratorType. Submission fails with: '400 Accelerator "NVIDIA_L4" is not supported for machine type "a2-highgpu-1g"'. There is no machineType parameter exposed on proposeTrainingJob/submitTrainingJob to override this. Need either (a) auto-pick a g2-standard-* machine when acceleratorType=NVIDIA_L4, or (b) expose a machineType arg.

context.reason: 400 Accelerator "NVIDIA_L4" is not supported for machine type "a2-highgpu-1g"
context.note: merged config from proposeTrainingJob showed machineType:a2-highgpu-1g hardcoded for style-lora kind

title: style-lora submit fails: trainer image missing in Artifact Registry
summary: submitTrainingJob for kind=style-lora failed with 404: image europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/mmo-mw-prod/mmo-training/acestep-trainer:latest does not exist. Blocks all style/user LoRA training in west-eu. Needs the acestep-trainer image to be built and pushed to that AR repo (or the configured imageUri updated).
